content:
name: Work Packet execution issue
about: Project an existing canonical Work Packet into GitHub for execution tracking.
title: "[WP] "
body:
  - type: input
    id: identifier
    attributes:
      label: Work Packet identifier
      placeholder: WP-MVP-XXXX
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: input
    id: path
    attributes:
      label: Canonical Work Packet path
      placeholder: engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-XXXX.md
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: input
    id: branch
    attributes:
      label: Authorized branch
      placeholder: wp/...
  - type: textarea
    id: acceptance
    attributes:
      label: Acceptance / validation summary
      description: Do not duplicate the canonical packet; summarize and link it.
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: checkboxes
    id: gates
    attributes:
      label: Authorization gates
      options:
        - label: Canonical Work Packet is Ready
          required: true
        - label: Required ADR/specification dependencies are resolved
          required: true
        - label: Scope and prohibited changes are explicit
          required: true
